option_relations.rationale: Right Bundle Branch Block (RBBB) and cardiac arrest due to hypoxemia from COPD exacerbation are manifestations or complications of COPD with acute respiratory failure.
Malignant arrhythmia or conduction system abnormality can be a manifestation or complication of severe hypoxemia and respiratory failure, which is part of COPD with acute respiratory failure.
Acute exacerbation of COPD leading to respiratory failure is clinically equivalent to COPD with Acute Respiratory Failure.
Acute COPD exacerbation with respiratory failure is clinically equivalent to COPD with Acute Respiratory Failure.
